cohort: Infants with birth trauma seen within six weeks of life and a control group of randomly selected similar infants without birth trauma.
finding: Breech presentation, vaginal delivery, congenital malformation, instrument-assisted delivery, and birth weight above 3.5Kg were significantly associated with birth trauma.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was significantly associated with birth trauma.
birth_weight: N/A (but study included birth weights above 3.5 kg)
